sonnet.problem: This true/false statement re-asks a fact the baker already saw answered on card 4 (Abraham's faith credited as righteousness). It also restates the premise of card 8's question, which already says the person doesn't work but believes.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact.

sonnet.problem: The joke says the biggest thing anybody ever handed Papa Dorin was a spot in the back of a junk drawer. His backstory says the Most High gave him a whole cookie planet, the Dorinverse, so the joke contradicts it.
sonnet.rule: They fit the backstory, never change it, and don't contradict each other in one lesson.
